Container.Name: PrintMaster-Server
Container.Overview: PrintMaster Server - Printer fleet management system for MSPs, MPS providers, copier dealers, and IT departments. This template pins a reviewed image tag; keep the HTTP port private and publish the HTTPS endpoint through a trusted reverse proxy.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: HTTP backend/redirect port. Keep the host port private; do not expose it to the Internet.

Config.Name: HTTPS Port
Config.Description: HTTPS management endpoint. Use a trusted certificate or terminate TLS at a reverse proxy.

Config.Name: Config File
Config.Description: Configuration file (optional - will use defaults if not provided)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Host user id to run container as (99 is Unraid nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Host group id to run container as (100 is Unraid users).

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Required initial administrator password; use at least 16 random characters and keep this value secret.

Config.Name: HTTP Port (Env)
Config.Description: HTTP backend/redirect port inside the container.

Config.Name: Behind Reverse Proxy
Config.Description: Set to 'true' if using Nginx Proxy Manager or similar

Config.Name: Bind Address
Config.Description: Container-only bind address; keep published host ports private.

Config.Name: TLS Mode
Config.Description: TLS mode: self-signed, custom, or letsencrypt. Configure a trusted certificate for public access.

Config.Name: Trusted Proxies
Config.Description: Only the reverse proxy IP/CIDR; never trust all clients.

Config.Name: External HTTPS URL
Config.Description: Canonical public HTTPS URL, for example https://printmaster.example.com.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: Logging level: debug, info, warn, error

Config.Name: Disable Self-Update
Config.Description: Keep privileged automatic updates disabled unless separately reviewed.
